children.text: We created a contemporary web presence for Thomas Custom Marine, an Ontario-based marine fabrication business and Certified SeaDek Fabricator.
Design elements were crafted to differentiate the client from competitors, supported by custom video production and cinemagraph assets.
A specialised integration combines Google Maps with Webflow's CMS to power a business locator tool, and the site also incorporates an online product catalogue for browsing their offerings.

subtitle: New Website & Custom Graphics
summary: A sleek, modern Webflow website for Ontario's certified SeaDek fabricator, featuring custom video, cinemagraphs and a Google Maps powered business locator.
title: Thomas Custom Marine
